messages:
maria: quick status check — HK region provisioning: cloud infra says we passed infra provisioning but firewall rules are still pending approval from Network. blocked for rollout until that lands.
kevin: I can take the firewall rule ownership. which rule ID? cc: @josh for the routing policy PR.
josh: ping — PR #4582 contains the routing policy and the BGP community tagging we need. waiting on kevin for the final acl allowlist. link: https://git.local/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4582
maria: rule id is fw-hk-2026-07. Network wants to know if we need 0.0.0.0/0 or just the cloud provider SNAT CIDRs.
kevin: safe to scope to provider SNATs only. I will add the allowlist and request approval today.
tara: quick question on data residency — are access logs still routed to EU logging stack? we need HK audit logging for customers with residency requirements.
nina: yes, today logs are shipped to logs-eu by default. we have the route + sink for logs-hk but it isn't hooked up to the HK region yet. that's a separate step in the playbook (step 4).
maria: ok action items: 1) kevin -> add allowlist & request firewall approval (owner) 2) nina -> enable logs-hk sink and validate (owner) 3) josh -> merge PR 4582 once kevin confirms acl 4) tara -> coordinate with compliance for residency sign-off. target milestone: canary on Mon (72h).
kevin: working on ACL now, will drop the snippet here when ready.
kevin: ```
# routing policy snippet
{"policy": "edge-to-region", "match": "hk-*", "next_hop": "vpc-hk-01", "community": "no-export"}
```
josh: noted. once kevin posts the final diff i'll run a quick smoke in staging and tag @deploy-bot to schedule the canary.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: hk-region-canary-2026-03-16T23:00Z — will notify channel on completion.
tara: compliance confirmed they'll review residency tests midday tomorrow. thumbs up if timeline looks ok. :+1:
maria: timeline ok for me. kevin ping when firewall is submitted and i'll update the rollout doc. thanks all. :rocket:
